• Qatar North Field East LNG expansion nears startup — first gas expected in November.

📊 Markets & Macro
• Mortgage rates jump to 7.49% — near 3-year highs, worsening U.S. housing affordability and weakening applications.
• NY Fed inflation expectations rise sharply — 1-year view jumped to 3.9%, highest since May 2023, reinforcing sticky-inflation worries.
• U.S. stocks and bonds sell off globally — Europe and U.S. both weakened as French/UK yields surged and the dollar firmed.
• France under bond-market pressure — more short-term issuance considered as 10Y yields jump; officials say no broader contagion yet.
• UK gilt yields hit 1998 highs — 30Y gilts above 6% as global duration stress deepens.

🌍 Geopolitical
• U.S.-Iran talks stall — Tehran rejected Washington’s nuclear proposals, demanding enrichment rights and sanctions relief first.
• White House weighing Iran strike options before midterms — reports say Pentagon planning is underway, keeping geopolitics front and center.
• Russia/Ukraine spillover hits trade — Black Sea attacks disrupted sunflower oil shipments to India.

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• Bitcoin drops under $83K — crypto sentiment stayed firm overall, but price action weakened with risk assets.
• Tether to explore tokenization with Kazakhstan central bank — another sign of stablecoin expansion into public-sector pilots.
• Wells Fargo in talks with Kraken parent for crypto liquidity — traditional finance still pushing deeper into crypto rails.
• CFTC says it will deliver clear crypto rules — signals a more defined U.S. regulatory path.

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• Trump to unveil $1B+ AI science push — White House summit to back Genesis Mission and broader AI-industrial policy.
• FCC moves against Chinese labs — proposal would bar certain Chinese test labs from certifying U.S.-bound devices.
• EU/China trade tensions rise — Beijing rejected voluntary curbs on hybrid exports as Brussels weighs tougher measures.
• EU approves ~1,650 new Russia sanctions listings — further tightening tied to the war.
• NY Fed intervened in FX for Treasury — rare market action underscores stress in currency markets.

🏢 Corporate
• Microsoft unveils local AI models + execution containers — major push for on-device AI and agent security; also new Surface hardware.
